preferences.title: Accessibility
preferences.intro: These settings apply immediately and are remembered on this device.
preferences.motionHint: Reduced motion removes animated movement but keeps all content and highlights.
preferences.soundHint: Play a quiet tone for success and errors. A visible message is always shown too.

language.title: Language
language.intro: The layout switches direction with the language. Your entries and the open screen are kept.

prototypeTools.title: Prototype tools
prototypeTools.label: Show the design system lab in menus and search
prototypeTools.description: For people reviewing the prototype. Clients never see it in their workspace; its addresses keep working either way.

textSize.welcomeTitle: Choose the text size that’s comfortable for you
textSize.welcomeBody: Tap a size and the page changes straight away. You can change it later in settings.
textSize.changeLater: You can change this any time: account menu → Text size.
textSize.settingsHint: Applies straight away on every screen of this app, for you in this organisation.
